items.title: No chat backup if you change your phone!
items.text: This App is USELESS if you’re counting on trying to restore your chat history when changing your phone! I’m livid - if I could give it zero stars I would. There is no customer helpline, only standard Troubleshooting guides, which all leave out the key info which they only say in their standard-form email reply :”We aren't able to help you restore your chats, documents, media files, backups, or call history. In most cases, the chat history and media files can only be found on your phone or the recipient's phone.” They omit to say this - funnily - in their marketing blurb about how you can backup all your data and restore your chat history from the cloud at the touch of a button. That is NOT true. The App does NOT systematically back up to the cloud, even if it claims to: it backs up to your PHONE. So if you change your phone, or SIM card, EVEN if you keep your number/have enough space in the cloud/connect to WiFi/ enable your iCloud Drive ... blah blah.. and do ALL the things you’re supposed to do, just FORGET about retrieving your data.SORT IT OUT WhatsApp - many customers are now writing about this problem. Your blanket claims re: backup are, frankly, misleading advertising. And your customer service is non-existent. Do better please.

items.title: Amazing
items.text: WhatsApp is really good however it’s a bit hard to find some stuff and you can customise your own profile picture and you can also add a sentence about you underneath your profile picture. And say if you upgraded from messages to WhatsApp then if you had a friend who can’t find WhatsApp in the App Store then you can invite them to WhatsApp by sending an invitation in settings. Also you can turn on disappearing messages but if someone clicks on your message then they can keep the messages stopping it from disappearing from that specific person. Along with that if you’re in a group chat then you can click on your message and then info to see who has read it and you can send a message where you can only red it once. And same with if you’re on a group chat then you can easily just block one person from that group which does mean you can still see the group chat messages it’s just that you can’t see the person’s message(s) if they send any since you have blocked them.Thank you WhatsApp for helping me over the past 9 years!

items.title: BEWARE!!! Not private; easily hacked.
items.text: Since 2022 I started noticing messages being opened when I had not even been anywhere near my phone. Contacted WhatsApp support once I had evidence (ex partners messages only) to show from screenshots. Was completely dismissed by WhatsApp support as nothing wrong with my account. It was not logged into a computer which I had checked so was being accessed remotely. This person was also repeatedly saying things (the most random things) I had said verbatim which such consistency it could not be considered a coincidence. I live 2.5hrs away since 2022 also since they knew where and when I was working and taking breaks etc. after notifying WhatsApp a number of times with evidence of messages being opened and dismissed as well as having so much evidence of abuse, bizarre gaslighting etc to show police/family court (we have a 3yr old son), all of a sudden one day in May this year, ALL of my messages from this person and this person only disappeared without me having touched my phone!!! Again contacted WhatsApp to show this and low and behold was told my WhatsApp was working perfectly nothing wrong with my account.  No investigation just an instant reply. Not a robust app whatsoever. Obviously can be hacked so not private and zero customer support in spite of evidence. Not going to delete my only evidence I have of being stalked am I and then whine about it. Jesus god help me someone. WhatsApp surely won’t (undermines their credibility most likely that’s it’s so easily done).

items.title: Becoming unreliable
items.text: The last few months every now and then it just stops working and says that I have gone against some terms, I send an appeal asking what I am supposed to have done and then 24 hours or not long before I get a response saying that they are sorry for the mistake and that I can continue to use the app! I have asked every time what they think I am supposed to have done or why it keeps happening but I don’t seem to get any answers and it’s more frustrating when you haven’t saved the number in your phone or your in the middle of messaging and it all of a sudden cuts off! And as far as I’m aware it doesn’t inform people or put something on your account to tell anyone that your WhatsApp is unavailable so people have assumed that I am just ignoring them which is even more annoying! I wish they could either explain why this happens or fix whatever the problem is as I am not aware of any other messaging application that is similar and as widely known as this! So I used to think highly of this app but since this has been happening it’s gone down down and I’m getting very annoyed with it, I have to tell everyone that if I don’t reply then please text as it keeps stopping me using it and then apologising! Not impressed and I can’t seem to find a support chat other than being told to go through the settings, but I can’t when they stop it working so it’s useless then!!!!!

items.title: Review from a blind persons perspective.
items.text: I use WhatsApp every single day for important daily communication with my friends, family and business contacts. For four years I have enjoyed the app significantly to do things such as text messaging, voice messaging and voice calling. However, I am really disappointed with the recent performance of WhatsApp. As a totally blind individual I rely on screen reading technology through the use of Apple’s VoiceOver for iPhone. And the most recent WhatsApp update has completely broken the navigation with VoiceOver for us as blind people. For example, when I’m in a chat and I want to send a voice message I do a certain gesture which lets me record my voice message. About 10 seconds into my record recording VoiceOver losers focus and loses my place on the screen and I can no longer get past what is called the vertical scroll bar. Which means VoiceOver is trapped in the Recording of the voice message. Even with the additional screen recognition feature the Apple provides the app is barely usable for not only me but others in the blind and visually impaired community who use WhatsApp as their daily messaging app. So as of right now, the app is barely usable to me. I am really disappointed with this service as this is my way of communicating to everyone in my life. And the fact that WhatsApp can just release updates that break things is just unacceptable. I would recommend people, especially people who are blind to stay away from WhatsApp for the foreseeable future until they decide to fix this huge bug.

items.title: Superb app but anti-disabled
items.text: This is an excellent app and well designed. However the sign in process on the iPad is unnecessarily ridiculous and really hard if you’re physically disabled. If you have a physical disability like I have (tetraplegic) you have to wait to ask your support worker or someone else to help you link your iPad to the WhatsApp app on the iPhone, because you can’t sign in on an iPad for some reason. Then when you go to the WhatsApp app in the iPhone to link your iPad, it won’t do it unless you use fingerprint verification(and yes, fingerprint unlocking is turned off in the WhatsApp settings before anyone thinks of that, it doesn’t matter apparently). So then because you don’t use fingerprint security when you’re paralysed from the neck down., you'll have to ask your support worker to try and hold your thumb on the iPhone to create one, which is not easy when you're paralysed, and then go back to the WhatsApp app then try and get your thumb in the proper place with help just to start the link Device malarkey in the WhatsApp app. This is a brilliant app and you must have some superb coders clearly, so surely it can't be that hard to adapt the iPad app so you can just sign in normally, please. I had friends who were down in the area for a week wanting to catch up with me and they use the WhatsApp app to check if I’m alright to take visitors, but I missed them because I didn’t realise I was signed out until late, and then I had to wait several hours until I had help again. Please fix this guys.

items.title: Just so u can see I voted a 5
items.text: WhatsApp has become an absolute nightmare to use. I have now been banned six times, despite doing nothing wrong, and it is honestly beyond frustrating. Getting banned repeatedly for no clear reason is completely unacceptable, especially when I rely on WhatsApp to communicate with people. It is incredibly annoying and, quite frankly, embarrassing to suddenly find yourself banned when you haven’t done anything wrong. Every time it happens, I’m left wondering what I supposedly did to deserve it. Being treated as if I’ve broken the rules when I haven’t is extremely frustrating. What makes it even worse is how difficult it can be to get the issue resolved. You can lose access to your account and important conversations, and you’re basically left having to appeal and wait, hoping someone actually looks into the situation properly. Then, even after getting your account back, it can happen again. Six bans is ridiculous. At this point, using WhatsApp feels stressful rather than convenient because I’m constantly worried that I’ll be banned again for absolutely no reason. A messaging app should not make its users feel like they are doing something wrong when they aren’t.
